question: Which of the following is a soft dehydrate naturally occurring mineral composed of calcium sulphate dihydrate widely used to manufacture wallboards that are used to cover walls and ceilings?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gypsum.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gypsum** is a **soft dehydrate** naturally occurring mineral composed of **calcium sulphate dihydrate.**
 
• It is widely used in the manufacturing of wallboards that are used to cover** walls and ceilings.**
 
• Gypsum is also used in the production of **plaster of Paris, fertilizer, and as a soil conditioner.**
 
• It is a **non-toxic mineral **and is safe for use in construction and agriculture.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Limestone** is a** sedimentary rock **composed mainly of **calcium carbonate.**

 
 
• It is used in the production of **cement and concrete.**
 
 
 
• **Dolomite** is a mineral composed of **calcium magnesium carbonate.**
 
 
• It is used in the production of **steel and glass**.
 
 
 
• **Barytes,** also known as barite, is a mineral composed of **barium sulfate**.
 
 
• It is used in **drilling fluids,** as a filler in **paints and plastics,** and in the production of **oil and gas.**
